The '''54th Directors Guild of America Awards''', honoring the outstanding directorial achievements in [[film director|film]]s, [[documentary]] and [[television director|television]] in 2001, were presented on March 9, 2002, at the [[Hyatt Regency Century Plaza]].<ref>{{cite web|title=DGA Announces Winners of 2001 Outstanding Directorial Achievement Awards and Recipients|url=https://www.dga.org/News/PressReleases/2002/0309-DGA-Announces-Winners-of-2001-Outstanding-Directorial-Achievement-Awards-and-Recipients.aspx|publisher=Directors Guild of America|access-date=January 26, 2018|date=March 9, 2002}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|last1=Susman|first1=Gary|title=Directors Guild honors Ron Howard for ''Mind''|url=http://ew.com/article/2002/03/13/directors-guild-honors-ron-howard-mind/|website=Entertainment Weekly|access-date=January 26, 2018|date=March 13, 2002}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last1=Welkos|first1=Robert|title=Ron Howard Wins Acclaim of Directors|url=https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-2002-mar-10-me-dga10-story.html|access-date=January 26, 2018|work=Los Angeles Times|date=March 10, 2002}}</ref> The ceremony was hosted by [[Carl Reiner]].<ref>{{cite web|title=DGA Sets Host and Presenters for 54th Annual DGA Awards Dinner|url=https://www.dga.org/News/PressReleases/2002/0226-DGA-Sets-Host-and-Presenters-for-54th-Annual-DGA-Awards-Dinner.aspx|publisher=Directors Guild of America|access-date=January 26,
